source_title: Shubham Saxena is new VC BDA - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Bhubaneswar: Odisha govt on Tuesday effected a reshuffle in the IAS cadre and appointed Shubham Saxena as the new vice-chairman of Bhubaneswar Development Authority (BDA), replacing Chanchal Rana. Poma Tudu, who has replaced Saxena, will now serve as the director of agriculture and food production.Vijay Amruta Kulange has been appointed as revenue divisional commissioner in the south division in Berhampur. Pranati Chhotray has been appointed managing director of OMFED, replacing Kulange. Chhotray will continue to serve as the additional secretary in the home department.Similarly, Sangram Keshari Mohapatra has now been appointed as the revenue divisional commissioner (north division) in Sambalpur with additional charge of chairman in-charge of Western Odisha Development Council (WODC). Gavali Parag Harshad has been appointed mission director in National Health Mission (NHM).Chakravarti Singh Rathore has been given additional charge of director, horticulture in addition to his existing position as director, technical education and training.
